targets.rawSql: SELECT started_at, record_key, batch_id, attempt, status, current_stage, duration_seconds, peak_memory_rss_mb, llm_requests, qdrant_queries, error_type, error_message, run_id FROM tender_autofill_job_runs WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at) ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT run_id, record_key, batch_id, seldon_id, attempt, worker_name, status, current_stage, started_at, heartbeat_at, finished_at, duration_seconds, peak_memory_rss_mb, error_type, error_message FROM tender_autofill_job_runs WHERE run_id = ${run_id:sqlstring}

SELECT llm_requests, llm_successes, llm_failures, llm_prompt_tokens, llm_completion_tokens, llm_total_tokens, llm_fallbacks, embedding_queries, embedding_http_requests, qdrant_queries, qdrant_http_requests, qdrant_results, documents_requested, documents_parsed, download_bytes, warnings_count FROM tender_autofill_job_runs WHERE run_id = ${run_id:sqlstring}

SELECT event_time, event_type, stage, status, service, operation, model, primary_model, duration_seconds, memory_rss_mb, http_status, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, result_count, byte_count, error_type, error_message, details FROM tender_autofill_job_events WHERE run_id = ${run_id:sqlstring} ORDER BY event_time, event_id
SELECT stage AS metric, duration_seconds AS value FROM tender_autofill_job_events WHERE run_id = ${run_id:sqlstring} AND event_type = 'stage' AND status IN ('completed','failed') ORDER BY event_id

SELECT event_time, operation, status, primary_model, model AS actual_model, duration_seconds, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens, provider_request_id, error_message FROM tender_autofill_job_events WHERE run_id = ${run_id:sqlstring} AND service = 'llm' ORDER BY event_id

list.definition: SELECT record_key FROM tender_autofill_job_runs GROUP BY record_key ORDER BY MAX(started_at) DESC LIMIT 1000

list.definition: SELECT run_id FROM tender_autofill_job_runs WHERE record_key = ${record_key:sqlstring} ORDER BY attempt DESC, started_at DESC

list.query: SELECT run_id FROM tender_autofill_job_runs WHERE record_key = ${record_key:sqlstring} ORDER BY attempt DESC, started_at DESC
